scenes.title: Thirty-Five Minutes
scenes.summary: Mazen panics over the double-booked room while Tariq unlocks the third-floor staircase.

scenes.title: The Sunny Attic
scenes.summary: Up in the quiet attic room, Nour, Tariq, and Salma inspect the space and list what is missing.

scenes.title: Left at the Landing
scenes.summary: Nour, Salma, and Mazen finish making the bed, plug in the warm lamp, and hear the front gate bell.

scenes.title: In from the Rain
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Rami arrives soaked from the rain, and Nour and Salma warm him up before explaining the room change.

scenes.title: Half Price and Quiet Beams
scenes.summary: Shown the cozy attic room at half price, Rami admires the timber ceiling and happily takes the key.

scenes.title: A Five-Star Sigh of Relief
scenes.summary: Downstairs Mazen celebrates the solved double-booking until Nour spots a small leather notebook left on the counter.

scenes.title: Returning the Notebook
scenes.summary: Nour returns Rami's leather notebook and hears the radiator pipe clank and go lukewarm.

scenes.title: Ice-Cold Pipes
scenes.summary: Coming up from the cellar, Tariq delivers bad news: the hot-water boiler valve just cracked for the night.
